note: Tests whether the 30B MoE's repetition loops are a sampling-setting effect. Established so far: repetition_frac is 0.63-0.70 on the 30B and exactly 0.0 on both dense models at the same temperature 1.0; truncation is 0.992 regardless of the length cap; and trainer/engine weights are verified equal, so it is not a weight-sync fault. What is left is that temperature 1.0 sits above Qwen3-30B-A3B's own generation_config (0.6 / top_p 0.95 / top_k 20). If 0.6 clears the repetition, the 30B becomes measurable -- but at a temperature the 4B/8B cells did not use, so it stops being the same-conditions third point of the model-scale axis and becomes a separate finding about MoE fragility.
